name: – Andreas Schieder – After § 17 – Am 9
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Albania
part_text: 17a. Calls on Albania to fully respect the autonomy of the Autocephalous Orthodox Church of Albania and to refrain from any action undermining its freedom of religious expression or its property rights; calls for an end to interference in ecclesiastical appointments and for dialogue with the religious authorities with a view to safeguarding religious pluralism and religious heritage;
